source.description:
Ho Ka-Kui: Hong Kong’s Iconic Villain

Ho Ka-Kui earned renown in Hong Kong cinema as one of the "Four Great Villains," delivering chilling performances in crime and action films. His intense portrayal of a perverse character in "Rebels of the Neon God" cemented his reputation for bringing complex antagonists to life.

Off-screen, Ho Ka-Kui faced personal demons, including drug addiction and compulsive gambling. These struggles depleted his finances and left him living in isolation.
